5980c241-915a-4643-8f4f-065536bfce4c.example: The heart of the website was a database of tourism services operators, both those based in New Zealand and those based abroad which offered tourism services to the country.

e6f5a841-dc2f-4aef-bfa7-4a7cd73308e0.meaning: （在互联网上的）存在、展示；网络形象

e6f5a841-dc2f-4aef-bfa7-4a7cd73308e0.translation: 这意味着即使是最小的民宿地址或专业活动提供商也能获得网络存在感，接触到长途游客群体。
